```{r setup, include=FALSE}
clean_context <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "NoContext",
    tolower(x) %in% c("letters", "no context", "nocontext", "none", "na", "") ~ "NoContext",
    tolower(x) == "maze" ~ "Maze",
    tolower(x) == "melody" ~ "Melody",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}


clean_model_type <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    # Low-scale baseline
    x %in% c(
      "Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale",

    # High-scale baseline
    x %in% c(
      "Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale"
    ) ~ "High-Scale",

    # Low global scale + high context scale
    x %in% c(
      "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
      "Lazy-Rich-Context",
      "Lazy+RichCtx",
      "Lazy Rich-Context",
      "Low-High-Contex",
      "Low-High-Context",
      "Low+HighCtx",
      "Low-Scale-High-Context",
      "Low-Scale + High Context"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

    # High global scale + low context scale
    x %in% c(
      "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
      "Rich-Lazy-Context",
      "Rich+LazyCtx",
      "Rich Lazy-Context",
      "High-Low-Contex",
      "High-Low-Context",
      "High+LowCtx",
      "High-Scale-Low-Context",
      "High-Scale + Low Context"
    ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

  "High-Scale",
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context"
)

)

  "High-Scale" = "solid",
  "Low-Scale" = "22",
  "Low-Scale + High Context" = "dotdash",
  "High-Scale + Low Context" = "longdash"
)
```

```{r LearningCurves, echo=FALSE}
# =========================================================
# Learning trajectory plots with 2 x 2 model conditions
# Rich -> High-Scale
# Lazy/Poor -> Low-Scale
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# ---------- Helpers ----------

minmax <- function(x) {
  r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (diff(r) == 0) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (x - r[1]) / diff(r)
}


# =========================================================
# 1) Maze-Melody transfer plot
# =========================================================

human_use <- rich_poor_learning_dynamics %>%
  filter(training_active == TRUE) %>%
  filter(counterbalance == 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rt)) %>%
  mutate(
    context = clean_context(context),
    context = factor(context, levels = context_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(context, block_id, sequence_in_block, global_step) %>%
  summarise(
    rt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(context) %>%
  mutate(rt_norm = minmax(rt)) %>%
  ungroup()

model_use <- rich_poor_learning_dynamics %>%
  filter(training_active == TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(loss)) %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
    context = clean_context(context)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_type)) %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
    context = factor(context, levels = context_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(model_type, context, block_id, sequence_in_block, global_step) %>%
  summarise(
    loss = mean(loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(model_type) %>%
  mutate(loss_norm = minmax(loss)) %>%
  ungroup()

model_line <- model_use %>%
  group_by(model_type, global_step) %>%
  summarise(
    loss_norm = mean(loss_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(model_type, global_step)

p_transfer <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = model_line,
    aes(
      x = global_step,
      y = loss_norm,
      linetype = model_type,
      group = model_type
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 3,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = human_use,
    aes(
      x = global_step,
      y = rt_norm,
      group = interaction(context, block_id),
      color = context
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.6,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = human_use,
    aes(
      x = global_step,
      y = rt_norm,
      color = context
    ),
    size = 5,
    alpha = 0.90,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = context_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = model_linetypes, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative Sequence",
    y = "Normalized Performance",
    color = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 2,
      linetype = "solid"
    ),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.3, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 34)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 16,
        size = 7,
        alpha = 1,
        linewidth = 0
      )
    ),
    linetype = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 3)
    )
  )

p_transfer

# =========================================================
# 2) Reusable plotting function for single-context conditions
# =========================================================

make_transfer_plot <- function(df, title = NULL, common_legend = FALSE) {

  if (!("context" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(context = "NoContext")
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(context = clean_context(context))

  # ---- Human ----
  human_use <- df %>%
    filter(training_active == TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rt)) %>%
    group_by(context, block_id, sequence_in_block, global_step) %>%
    summarise(
      rt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(context) %>%
    mutate(rt_norm = minmax(rt)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # ---- Model ----
  model_use <- df %>%
    filter(training_active == TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(loss)) %>%
    mutate(model_type = clean_model_type(model_type)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(model_type)) %>%
    mutate(model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels)) %>%
    group_by(model_type, context, block_id, sequence_in_block, global_step) %>%
    summarise(
      loss = mean(loss, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(model_type) %>%
    mutate(loss_norm = minmax(loss)) %>%
    ungroup()

  model_line <- model_use %>%
    group_by(model_type, global_step) %>%
    summarise(
      loss_norm = mean(loss_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(model_type, global_step)

  # ---- Context color scale ----
  if (common_legend) {
    human_use <- human_use %>%
      mutate(context = factor(context, levels = context_levels))

    color_scale <- scale_color_manual(values = context_cols, drop = FALSE)

  } else {
    present_ctx <- sort(unique(as.character(human_use$context)))

    human_use <- human_use %>%
      mutate(context = factor(context, levels = present_ctx))

    color_scale <- scale_color_manual(
      values = context_cols[present_ctx],
      drop = TRUE
    )
  }

  ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = model_line,
      aes(
        x = global_step,
        y = loss_norm,
        linetype = model_type,
        group = model_type
      ),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 3,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = human_use,
      aes(
        x = global_step,
        y = rt_norm,
        group = interaction(context, block_id),
        color = context
      ),
      linewidth = 2,
      alpha = 0.6,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = human_use,
      aes(
        x = global_step,
        y = rt_norm,
        color = context
      ),
      size = 5,
      alpha = 0.90,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    color_scale +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = model_linetypes, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Cumulative Sequence",
      y = "Normalized Performance",
      color = NULL,
      linetype = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 2,
        linetype = "solid"
      ),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.3, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 26),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 34),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 26,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          shape = 16,
          size = 7,
          alpha = 1,
          linewidth = 0
        )
      ),
      linetype = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(linewidth = 3)
      )
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 3) Make single-context plots
# =========================================================
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
 # =========================================================
# SRN loss graph with 2 x 2 model conditions
# Rich -> High-Scale
# Lazy/Poor -> Low-Scale
# =========================================================
srn_theme <- theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 4),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 36, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.3, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 36),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 36)
  )
model_use <- rich_poor_learning_dynamics %>%
  filter(training_active == TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(loss)) %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
    context = clean_context(context)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_type)) %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
    context = factor(context, levels = context_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    participant_id, model_type, context, block_id,
    sequence_in_block, global_step, counterbalance
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    loss = mean(loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

model_line <- model_use %>%
  filter(counterbalance == 1) %>%
  group_by(model_type, context, global_step, block_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_loss = mean(loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_loss = sd(loss, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(loss))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(model_type, context, block_id, global_step)

model_line <- model_line %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = factor(
      model_type,
      levels = c(
        "Low-Scale",
        "Low-Scale + High Context",
        "High-Scale + Low Context",
        "High-Scale"
      )
    )
  )
srnLossGraph <- ggplot(
  model_line,
  aes(
    x = global_step,
    y = mean_loss,
    color = context,
    fill = context,
    group = interaction(context, block_id)
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_loss - se_loss,
      ymax = mean_loss + se_loss
    ),
    alpha = 0.12,
    linetype = 0,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 3,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ model_type, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = context_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = context_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative Sequence",
    y = "Loss",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  srn_theme +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 3))
  )

srnLossGraph

      "Melody" = "dashed",
      "NoContext" = "dotted"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative Sequence",
    y = "Loss",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  srn_theme +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 3)),
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

srnLossGraph_all
```

```{r, PCA echo=FALSE}
# =========================================================
# PCA plots with 2 x 2 model conditions
# Rich -> High-Scale
# Lazy/Poor -> Low-Scale
# Includes hybrid context-scale conditions
# =========================================================

# ---------- Helpers ----------

clean_model_type <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c(
      "Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale"
    ) ~ "High-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
      "Lazy-Rich-Context",
      "Lazy+RichCtx",
      "Lazy Rich-Context",
      "Low-High-Contex",
      "Low-High-Context",
      "Low+HighCtx",
      "Low-Scale-High-Context",
      "Low-Scale + High Context"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
      "Rich-Lazy-Context",
      "Rich+LazyCtx",
      "Rich Lazy-Context",
      "High-Low-Contex",
      "High-Low-Context",
      "High+LowCtx",
      "High-Scale-Low-Context",
      "High-Scale + Low Context"
    ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

clean_context <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "NoContext",
    tolower(x) %in% c(
      "letters", "no context", "nocontext", "none", "na", ""
    ) ~ "NoContext",
    tolower(x) == "maze" ~ "Maze",
    tolower(x) == "melody" ~ "Melody",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

rescale_alpha <- function(x) {
  if (length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 1) {
    return(rep(1, length(x)))
  }

  scales::rescale(x, to = c(0.25, 1.0))
}

model_levels <- c(
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context",
  "High-Scale"
)

context_levels <- c("Maze", "Melody", "NoContext")

context_cols <- c(
  Maze = "blue",
  Melody = "red",
  NoContext = "black"
)

clean_pca_df <- function(df) {

  if ("model_type" %in% names(df) && !("Model_Type" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% rename(Model_Type = model_type)
  }

  if ("context" %in% names(df) && !("Context" %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>% rename(Context = context)
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      Model_Type = clean_model_type(Model_Type),
      Context = clean_context(Context),
      Model_Type = factor(Model_Type, levels = model_levels),
      Context = factor(Context, levels = context_levels)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Model_Type))
}

make_pca_mean <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Model_Type, Context, step_in_sequence) %>%
    summarise(
      PC1 = mean(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
      PC2 = mean(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

get_pca_lims <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      xmin = min(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
      xmax = max(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
      ymin = min(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
      ymax = max(PC2, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

pca_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 2,
      linetype = "solid"
    ),
    legend.key.size = unit(2, "cm"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 34),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 26)
  )

legend_circles <- guides(
  fill = "none",
  color = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      shape = 16,
      size = 8,
      alpha = 1,
      linewidth = 0
    )
  )
)

make_pca_model_plot <- function(pca_mean, model_label, title_suffix, lims) {

  d <- pca_mean %>%
    filter(Model_Type == model_label) %>%
    arrange(Context, step_in_sequence) %>%
    group_by(Context) %>%
    mutate(step_alpha = rescale_alpha(step_in_sequence)) %>%
    ungroup()

  starts <- d %>%
    group_by(Context) %>%
    slice_min(step_in_sequence, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  ends <- d %>%
    group_by(Context) %>%
    slice_max(step_in_sequence, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(d, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_path(
      aes(group = Context, color = Context),
      linewidth = 5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = Context, alpha = step_alpha),
      size = 8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = starts,
      aes(color = Context),
      size = 8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ends,
      aes(color = Context),
      size = 8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      xlim = c(lims$xmin[[1]], lims$xmax[[1]]),
      ylim = c(lims$ymin[[1]], lims$ymax[[1]])
    ) +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_manual(values = context_cols) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(model_label, " (", title_suffix, ")"),
      x = "PC1",
      y = "PC2",
      color = "Context"
    ) +
    pca_theme +
    legend_circles
}

make_pca_plot_list <- function(pca_mean, title_suffix, lims) {
  present_models <- model_levels[
    model_levels %in% as.character(unique(pca_mean$Model_Type))
  ]

  plots <- lapply(
    present_models,
    function(m) {
      make_pca_model_plot(
        pca_mean = pca_mean,
        model_label = m,
        title_suffix = title_suffix,
        lims = lims
      )
    }
  )

  names(plots) <- present_models
  plots
}

strip_pca_axes <- function(p) {
  p + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
}

# =========================================================
# 1) Clean PCA data
# =========================================================

pca           <- clean_pca_df(pca)
pca_maze      <- clean_pca_df(pca_maze)
pca_melody    <- clean_pca_df(pca_melody)
pca_NoContext <- clean_pca_df(pca_NoContext)

# =========================================================
# 2) Switching-context PCA plots
# =========================================================

pca_mean <- make_pca_mean(pca)
lims <- get_pca_lims(pca_mean)

pca_two_plots <- make_pca_plot_list(
  pca_mean = pca_mean,
  title_suffix = "Two Contexts",
  lims = lims
)

pca_combo <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = pca_two_plots,
  ncol = 2,
  nrow = ceiling(length(pca_two_plots) / 2),
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right",
  align = "hv",
  font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold")
)

pca_combo

# Backward-compatible object names, in case later chunks use them
LowScalePCA <- pca_two_plots[["Low-Scale"]]
LowHighContextPCA <- pca_two_plots[["Low-Scale + High Context"]]
HighLowContextPCA <- pca_two_plots[["High-Scale + Low Context"]]
HighScalePCA <- pca_two_plots[["High-Scale"]]

poorPCA <- LowScalePCA
richPCA <- HighScalePCA

# =========================================================
# 3) Single-context PCA plots
# =========================================================

pca_single <- bind_rows(
  pca_maze %>%
    mutate(TrainContext = "Maze"),

  pca_melody %>%
    mutate(TrainContext = "Melody"),

  pca_NoContext %>%
    mutate(TrainContext = "NoContext")
) %>%
  mutate(
    TrainContext = factor(TrainContext, levels = context_levels),
    Context = TrainContext,
    Model_Type = factor(Model_Type, levels = model_levels)
  )

pca_single_mean <- make_pca_mean(pca_single)
lims_single <- get_pca_lims(pca_single_mean)

pca_single_plots <- make_pca_plot_list(

pca_combo_single <- ggarrange(

  legend = "right",
  align = "hv",
  labels = LETTERS[seq_along(pca_single_plots)],
  font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold")
)

pca_combo_single

# Backward-compatible object names, in case later chunks use them
LowScalePCA_single <- pca_single_plots[["Low-Scale"]]
LowHighContextPCA_single <- pca_single_plots[["Low-Scale + High Context"]]
HighLowContextPCA_single <- pca_single_plots[["High-Scale + Low Context"]]
HighScalePCA_single <- pca_single_plots[["High-Scale"]]

lazyPCA_single <- LowScalePCA_single
richPCA_single <- HighScalePCA_single

# =========================================================
# 4) Combined PCA figure
# Row 1 = single-context trajectories
# Row 2 = switching-context trajectories
# =========================================================

pca_single_plots_clean <- lapply(pca_single_plots, strip_pca_axes)
pca_two_plots_clean    <- lapply(pca_two_plots, strip_pca_axes)

pcaAll <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = c(pca_single_plots_clean, pca_two_plots_clean),
  labels = LETTERS[
    seq_len(length(pca_single_plots_clean) + length(pca_two_plots_clean))
  ],
  font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold"),

)

pcaAll <- annotate_figure(

  bottom = text_grob("PC1", size = 28)
)

pcaAll
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ggpubr)

# ==========================================================
# PCA splitting / null analyses with 2 x 2 model conditions
# Rich -> High-Scale
# Poor/Lazy -> Low-Scale
# ==========================================================

# ---------- Model helpers ----------
# Define these only if they do not already exist from earlier chunks.

if (!exists("model_levels")) {
  model_levels <- c(
    "Low-Scale",
    "Low-Scale + High Context",
    "High-Scale + Low Context",
    "High-Scale"
  )
}

if (!exists("context_levels")) {
  context_levels <- c("Maze", "Melody", "NoContext")
}

if (!exists("clean_model_type")) {
  clean_model_type <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)

    dplyr::case_when(
      x %in% c(
        "Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale"
      ) ~ "Low-Scale",

      x %in% c(
        "Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale"
      ) ~ "High-Scale",

      x %in% c(
        "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
        "Lazy-Rich-Context",
        "Lazy+RichCtx",
        "Lazy Rich-Context",
        "Low-High-Contex",
        "Low-High-Context",
        "Low+HighCtx",
        "Low-Scale-High-Context",
        "Low-Scale + High Context"
      ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

      x %in% c(
        "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
        "Rich-Lazy-Context",
        "Rich+LazyCtx",
        "Rich Lazy-Context",
        "High-Low-Contex",
        "High-Low-Context",
        "High+LowCtx",
        "High-Scale-Low-Context",
        "High-Scale + Low Context"
      ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  }
}

if (!exists("clean_context")) {
  clean_context <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)

    dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(x) ~ "NoContext",
      str_detect(tolower(x), "maze") ~ "Maze",
      str_detect(tolower(x), "melody") ~ "Melody",
      str_detect(tolower(x), "letter|no context|nocontext|none") ~ "NoContext",
      TRUE ~ x
    )
  }
}

add_scale_factors <- function(df, model_col = "Model_Type") {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      global_scale = case_when(
        .data[[model_col]] %in% c("Low-Scale", "Low-Scale + High Context") ~ "Low",
        .data[[model_col]] %in% c("High-Scale", "High-Scale + Low Context") ~ "High",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      context_scale = case_when(
        .data[[model_col]] %in% c("Low-Scale", "High-Scale + Low Context") ~ "Low",
        .data[[model_col]] %in% c("High-Scale", "Low-Scale + High Context") ~ "High",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      global_scale = factor(global_scale, levels = c("Low", "High")),
      context_scale = factor(context_scale, levels = c("Low", "High"))
    )
}

fix_model_type <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Model_Type = clean_model_type(Model_Type),
      Model_Type = factor(Model_Type, levels = model_levels)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Model_Type))
}

fix_context_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Context = clean_context(Context),
      Context = factor(Context, levels = context_levels)
    )
}

# ---------- Standardize PCA data ----------

pca <- pca %>%
  fix_model_type() %>%
  fix_context_labels() %>%
  mutate(Step = as.numeric(step_in_sequence))

pca_maze <- pca_maze %>%
  fix_model_type() %>%
  fix_context_labels() %>%
  mutate(Step = as.numeric(step_in_sequence))

pca_melody <- pca_melody %>%
  fix_model_type() %>%
  fix_context_labels() %>%
  mutate(Step = as.numeric(step_in_sequence))

# Sanity: mixed-context PCA must contain both Maze and Melody.
if (!all(c("Maze", "Melody") %in% unique(as.character(pca$Context)))) {
  stop("The mixed-context PCA dataframe does not contain both Maze and Melody.")
}

# ==========================================================
# 1) Primary inferential analysis:
#    within-net splitting index in two-context networks
# ==========================================================

mixed_centroids <- pca %>%
  filter(Context %in% c("Maze", "Melody")) %>%
  group_by(Model_Type, participant_id, Context) %>%
  summarise(
    c1 = mean(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    c2 = mean(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mixed_split <- mixed_centroids %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Context, values_from = c(c1, c2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(c1_Maze), !is.na(c1_Melody)) %>%
  mutate(
    d_split = sqrt(
      (c1_Maze - c1_Melody)^2 +
        (c2_Maze - c2_Melody)^2
    ),
    Source = "Within-net (Two Contexts)"
  ) %>%
  add_scale_factors("Model_Type")

# Four-condition test
fit_split_condition <- aov(d_split ~ Model_Type, data = mixed_split)
summary(fit_split_condition)

# 2 x 2 test: global scale x context scale
fit_split_2x2 <- aov(d_split ~ global_scale * context_scale, data = mixed_split)
summary(fit_split_2x2)

# ==========================================================
# 2) Null control:
#    compare within-net two-context distance to single-context null
# ==========================================================

mean_traj_mat <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Step) %>%
    summarise(
      m1 = mean(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
      m2 = mean(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Step) %>%
    select(m1, m2) %>%
    as.matrix()
}

align_points_rigid <- function(fit, Y) {
  R <- fit$rotation
  t <- fit$translation

  Y %*% R + matrix(
    rep(t, each = nrow(Y)),
    nrow = nrow(Y),
    ncol = 2
  )
}

perm_test_within_vs_null <- function(W, maze_cent, mel_cent, B = 20000, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)

  W <- W[is.finite(W)]
  nW <- length(W)

  n_maze <- nrow(maze_cent)
  n_mel <- nrow(mel_cent)

  replace_maze <- n_maze < nW
  replace_mel <- n_mel < nW

  T_obs <- mean(W)

  null_means <- replicate(B, {
    idx_m <- sample(seq_len(n_maze), size = nW, replace = replace_maze)
    idx_l <- sample(seq_len(n_mel), size = nW, replace = replace_mel)

    d_null <- sqrt(
      (maze_cent$c1[idx_m] - mel_cent$c1[idx_l])^2 +
        (maze_cent$c2[idx_m] - mel_cent$c2[idx_l])^2
    )

    mean(d_null, na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  p_less <- mean(null_means <= T_obs)
  p_gtr <- mean(null_means >= T_obs)
  p_two <- 2 * min(p_less, p_gtr)
  p_two <- min(p_two, 1)

  list(
    n_within = nW,
    mean_within = T_obs,
    mean_null = mean(null_means),
    p_within_less_than_null = p_less,
    p_within_greater_than_null = p_gtr,
    p_two_sided = p_two,
    null_means = null_means
  )
}

# Force single-context labels.
pca_maze <- pca_maze %>%
  mutate(Context = factor("Maze", levels = context_levels))

pca_melody <- pca_melody %>%
  mutate(Context = factor("Melody", levels = context_levels))

centroid_store <- list()
null_split_list <- list()
perm_results <- list()

within_counts <- mixed_split %>%
  group_by(Model_Type) %>%
  summarise(n_within = n(), .groups = "drop")

set.seed(1)

present_model_levels <- model_levels[
  model_levels %in% as.character(unique(mixed_split$Model_Type))
]

for (mt in present_model_levels) {

  maze_mt <- pca_maze %>%
    filter(Model_Type == mt, Context == "Maze")

  melody_mt <- pca_melody %>%
    filter(Model_Type == mt, Context == "Melody")

  if (nrow(maze_mt) == 0 || nrow(melody_mt) == 0) {
    warning("Skipping model type ", mt, ": missing MazeOnly or MelodyOnly data.")
    next
  }

  steps_common <- intersect(
    sort(unique(maze_mt$Step)),
    sort(unique(melody_mt$Step))
  )

  maze_mt <- maze_mt %>%
    filter(Step %in% steps_common)

  melody_mt <- melody_mt %>%
    filter(Step %in% steps_common)

  X_ref <- mean_traj_mat(maze_mt)
  Y_src <- mean_traj_mat(melody_mt)

  if (nrow(X_ref) < 3) {
    warning("Skipping model type ", mt, ": fewer than 3 shared steps.")
    next
  }

  fit_mt <- vegan::procrustes(
    X = X_ref,
    Y = Y_src,
    symmetric = FALSE
  )

  XY_aligned <- align_points_rigid(
    fit_mt,
    as.matrix(melody_mt[, c("PC1", "PC2")])
  )

  melody_aligned <- melody_mt %>%
    mutate(
      PC1a = XY_aligned[, 1],
      PC2a = XY_aligned[, 2]
    )

  maze_ref <- maze_mt %>%
    mutate(
      PC1a = PC1,
      PC2a = PC2
    )

  maze_cent <- maze_ref %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(
      c1 = mean(PC1a, na.rm = TRUE),
      c2 = mean(PC2a, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  mel_cent <- melody_aligned %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(
      c1 = mean(PC1a, na.rm = TRUE),
      c2 = mean(PC2a, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  centroid_store[[mt]] <- list(
    maze_cent = maze_cent,
    mel_cent = mel_cent
  )

  # Sanity check
  i <- sample(seq_len(nrow(maze_cent)), 1)
  j <- sample(seq_len(nrow(mel_cent)), 1)

  d_check <- sqrt(
    (maze_cent$c1[i] - mel_cent$c1[j])^2 +
      (maze_cent$c2[i] - mel_cent$c2[j])^2
  )

  if (!is.finite(d_check) || d_check < 1e-6) {
    warning(
      "Null alignment sanity check suspiciously small for ",
      mt,
      " (d ~ ",
      signif(d_check, 3),
      "). Check PC1/PC2 and Step matching."
    )
  }

  nW <- within_counts %>%
    filter(Model_Type == mt) %>%
    pull(n_within)

  if (length(nW) == 0) nW <- 0

  if (nW > 0 && nrow(maze_cent) > 0 && nrow(mel_cent) > 0) {
    idx_m <- sample(
      seq_len(nrow(maze_cent)),
      size = nW,
      replace = nrow(maze_cent) < nW
    )

    idx_l <- sample(
      seq_len(nrow(mel_cent)),
      size = nW,
      replace = nrow(mel_cent) < nW
    )

    null_split_list[[mt]] <- tibble(
      Model_Type = mt,
      d_split = sqrt(
        (maze_cent$c1[idx_m] - mel_cent$c1[idx_l])^2 +
          (maze_cent$c2[idx_m] - mel_cent$c2[idx_l])^2
      ),
      Source = "Null: different nets (Single Context)"
    )
  }

  W <- mixed_split %>%
    filter(Model_Type == mt) %>%
    pull(d_split)

  perm_results[[mt]] <- perm_test_within_vs_null(
    W = W,
    maze_cent = maze_cent,
    mel_cent = mel_cent,
    B = 20000,
    seed = 123
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# df should be your data frame
# e.g., df <- rich_poor_learning_dynamics

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

# =========================================================
# Model labels
# Rich -> High-Scale
# Poor/Lazy -> Low-Scale
# Adds hybrid context-scale conditions
# =========================================================

model_levels <- c(
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context",
  "High-Scale"
)

agent_levels <- c(
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context",
  "High-Scale",
  "Human"
)

cols4 <- c(
  "Low-Scale" = "red",
  "Low-Scale + High Context" = "orange",
  "High-Scale + Low Context" = "purple",
  "High-Scale" = "blue",
  "Human" = "grey"
)

clean_model_type <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale") ~ "Low-Scale",

    x %in% c("Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale") ~ "High-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
      "Lazy-Rich-Context",
      "Lazy+RichCtx",
      "Lazy Rich-Context",
      "Low-High-Contex",
      "Low-High-Context",
      "Low+HighCtx",
      "Low-Scale-High-Context",
      "Low-Scale + High Context"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
      "Rich-Lazy-Context",
      "Rich+LazyCtx",
      "Rich Lazy-Context",
      "High-Low-Contex",
      "High-Low-Context",
      "High+LowCtx",
      "High-Scale-Low-Context",
      "High-Scale + Low Context"
    ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 1) Prepare agent label + DV
#    - Models: use transfer_loss (or loss)
#    - Humans: use rt
#    - Z-score within agent for comparability
# -----------------------------

make_agent_dv <- function(df, model_dv = "transfer_loss", human_dv = "rt") {

  # human stream: same rows, but use rt
  human_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      agent = "Human",
      dv_raw = .data[[human_dv]]
    )

  # model stream: same rows, but use model DV and cleaned model_type label
  model_df <- df %>%
    mutate(agent = clean_model_type(model_type)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(agent)) %>%
    mutate(
      agent = factor(agent, levels = model_levels),
      dv_raw = .data[[model_dv]]
    )

  # combine into one long df
  bind_rows(human_df, model_df) %>%
    mutate(agent = as.character(agent)) %>%
    group_by(agent) %>%
    mutate(
      dv_z = as.numeric(scale(dv_raw))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# -----------------------------
# 2) Compute block-boundary transition costs
#    - Switch is detected by context changing across consecutive blocks
#    - IMPORTANT: humans keep all rows; models keep training_active == TRUE
# -----------------------------

compute_transition_cost <- function(df, dv, use_global_step = TRUE) {

  other_context <- function(x) {
    ifelse(
      x == "Maze", "Melody",
      ifelse(x == "Melody", "Maze", NA_character_)
    )
  }

  block <- df %>%
    filter(agent == "Human" | training_active == TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      context = case_when(
        agent == "Human" & "context" %in% names(.) &
          stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_to_lower(context), "maze") ~ "Maze",
        agent == "Human" & "context" %in% names(.) &
          stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_to_lower(context), "melody") ~ "Melody",
        TRUE ~ trimws(as.character(context))
      ),
      context = stringr::str_to_title(context)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(context)) %>%
    group_by(agent, participant_id, block_id, context) %>%
    summarise(
      dv_start = .data[[dv]][which.min(sequence_in_block)],
      dv_end = .data[[dv]][which.max(sequence_in_block)],
      block_order = if (use_global_step) {
        min(global_step, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        min(block_id, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(agent, participant_id, block_order)

  starts <- block %>%
    group_by(agent, participant_id) %>%
    slice_min(block_order, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      agent,
      participant_id,
      start_context = as.character(context)
    )

  block2 <- block %>%
    left_join(starts, by = c("agent", "participant_id")) %>%
    mutate(other = other_context(start_context)) %>%
    group_by(agent, participant_id) %>%
    mutate(
      prev_context = lag(as.character(context)),
      prev_end = lag(dv_end),
      is_transition = !is.na(prev_context),
      is_switch = is_transition & (as.character(context) != prev_context),

      # Original transition-cost definition: absolute boundary change
      trans_cost = if_else(
        is_transition,
        abs(dv_start - prev_end),
        NA_real_
      ),

      trans_type = case_when(
        !is_transition ~ NA_character_,
        is_switch ~ "switch",
        TRUE ~ "stay"
      ),
      trans_dir_raw = if_else(
        is_transition,
        paste0(prev_context, "→", as.character(context)),
        NA_character_
      ),
      trans_dir_norm = case_when(
        !is_transition ~ NA_character_,
        prev_context == start_context & as.character(context) == other ~ "A→B",
        prev_context == other & as.character(context) == start_context ~ "B→A",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  events <- block2 %>%
    filter(!is.na(trans_type)) %>%
    transmute(
      agent,
      participant_id,
      block_id,
      block_order,
      start_context,
      prev_context,
      context,
      trans_type,
      trans_dir_raw,
      trans_dir_norm,
      trans_cost
    )

  unit <- events %>%
    group_by(agent, participant_id, trans_type, trans_dir_norm) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cost = mean(trans_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trans = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(events = events, unit = unit, block = block2)
}

# -----------------------------
# 3) Condition-level metric extraction
#    - NoContext/Maze/Melody: use "stay" transitions
#    - Switch dataset: use "switch" transitions
# -----------------------------

compute_condition_metric <- function(df, condition, dv = "dv_z",
                                     want = c("stay", "switch"),
                                     switch_dir = c("any", "AtoB", "BtoA")) {
  want <- match.arg(want)
  switch_dir <- match.arg(switch_dir)

  res <- compute_transition_cost(df, dv = dv)

  out <- res$unit %>%
    filter(trans_type == want)

  if (want == "switch") {
    out <- out %>%
      filter(
        switch_dir == "any" |
          (switch_dir == "AtoB" & trans_dir_norm == "A→B") |
          (switch_dir == "BtoA" & trans_dir_norm == "B→A")
      )
  }

  out %>%
    group_by(agent, participant_id) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cost = mean(mean_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trans = sum(n_trans, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(condition = condition) %>%
    select(agent, participant_id, condition, mean_cost, n_trans)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# 1) Transition-cost data on loss

switch2_loss <- bind_rows(
  compute_condition_metric(no_df,     "NoContext", want = "stay"),
  compute_condition_metric(maze_df,   "Maze",      want = "stay"),
  compute_condition_metric(melody_df, "Melody",    want = "stay"),
  compute_condition_metric(switch_df, "Switch",    want = "switch", switch_dir = "any")
) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(

    agent = factor(agent, levels = names(model_cols))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(agent))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Summary with 95% CI
# ---------------------------------------------------------

sum_loss_ci <- switch2_loss %>%
  group_by(agent, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(mean_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(mean_cost)),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    tcrit = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_lo = mean - tcrit * se,
    ci_hi = mean + tcrit * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Common y-axis scale
# ---------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# =========================================================
# Matched-loss analyses
# Rich -> High-Scale
# Poor/Lazy -> Low-Scale
# Includes hybrid context-scale conditions
# =========================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)

# -----------------------------
# 0. Model label helpers
# -----------------------------

model_levels <- c(
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context",
  "High-Scale"
)

model_cols <- c(
  "Low-Scale" = "red",
  "Low-Scale + High Context" = "orange",
  "High-Scale + Low Context" = "purple",
  "High-Scale" = "blue"
)

clean_model_type <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c(
      "Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale"
    ) ~ "High-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
      "Lazy-Rich-Context",
      "Lazy+RichCtx",
      "Lazy Rich-Context",
      "Low-High-Contex",
      "Low-High-Context",
      "Low+HighCtx",
      "Low-Scale-High-Context",
      "Low-Scale + High Context"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
      "Rich-Lazy-Context",
      "Rich+LazyCtx",
      "Rich Lazy-Context",
      "High-Low-Contex",
      "High-Low-Context",
      "High+LowCtx",
      "High-Scale-Low-Context",
      "High-Scale + Low Context"
    ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 1. Clean and standardize data
# -----------------------------

matched_metrics <- matched_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
    ce_threshold = as.numeric(ce_threshold)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_type))

# -----------------------------
# 2. Helper to summarize metrics
# -----------------------------

summarize_metric <- function(data, metric_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by(model_type, ce_threshold) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(.data[[metric_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se_value = sd(.data[[metric_var]], na.rm = TRUE) /
        sqrt(sum(!is.na(.data[[metric_var]]))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(model_type, ce_threshold)
}

matchedContextDecode   <- summarize_metric(matched_metrics, "context_decodability")
matchedWeightRatio     <- summarize_metric(matched_metrics, "weight_ratio_cx_in")
matchedDimensionality  <- summarize_metric(matched_metrics, "effective_dimensionality")
matchedSeperation      <- summarize_metric(matched_metrics, "trajectory_separation")

# -----------------------------
# 3. Helper to make plots
# -----------------------------

plot_matched_metric <- function(plot_data, xlab) {
  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = mean_value,
      y = ce_threshold,
      color = model_type,
      fill = model_type
    )
  ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        xmin = mean_value - se_value,
        xmax = mean_value + se_value,
        group = model_type
      ),
      alpha = 0.10,
      linetype = 0,
      orientation = "y",
      na.rm = TRUE,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_path(
      aes(group = model_type),
      linewidth = 6,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = "Loss",
      color = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 2,
        linetype = "solid"
      ),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.3, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 26),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 34)
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# 4. Build all graphs
# -----------------------------

matchedContextDecodeGraph <- plot_matched_metric(
  matchedContextDecode,
  "Context Decodability"
)

matchedWeightRatioGraph <- plot_matched_metric(
  matchedWeightRatio,
  "Context Weight Ratio"
)

matchedDimensionalityGraph <- plot_matched_metric(
  matchedDimensionality,
  "Dimensionality"
)

matchedSeperationGraph <- plot_matched_metric(
  matchedSeperation,
  "PCA Trajectory Separation"
)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Print graphs
# -----------------------------

matchedContextDecodeGraph
matchedWeightRatioGraph
matchedDimensionalityGraph
matchedSeperationGraph

# =========================================================
# Matched stats - mixed effects
# Same analysis structure, now with four model conditions
# =========================================================

# -----------------------------
# 6. Add centered loss threshold
# -----------------------------

matched_metrics <- matched_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
    ce_threshold = as.numeric(ce_threshold),
    ce_c = scale(ce_threshold, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[, 1]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_type))

# -----------------------------
# 7. Helper to fit one model
# -----------------------------

fit_lme <- function(data, outcome) {
  formula_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ model_type * ce_c + (1 + ce_c || participant_id)")
  )

  model <- lmer(formula_full, data = data, REML = FALSE)

  # fallback if singular / unstable
  if (isSingular(model, tol = 1e-4)) {
    formula_simple <- as.formula(
      paste0(outcome, " ~ model_type * ce_c + (1 | participant_id)")
    )
    model <- lmer(formula_simple, data = data, REML = FALSE)
  }

  model
}

# -----------------------------
# 8. Fit models for each outcome
# -----------------------------

m_decode <- fit_lme(matched_metrics, "context_decodability")
m_weight <- fit_lme(matched_metrics, "weight_ratio_cx_in")
m_dim    <- fit_lme(matched_metrics, "effective_dimensionality")
m_sep    <- fit_lme(matched_metrics, "trajectory_separation")

# -----------------------------
# 9. Inspect results
# -----------------------------

anova(m_decode)
summary(m_decode)

anova(m_weight)
summary(m_weight)

anova(m_dim)
summary(m_dim)

anova(m_sep)
summary(m_sep)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# mixed effects models
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Model labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

model_levels <- c(
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context",
  "High-Scale"
)

clean_model_type <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale") ~ "Low-Scale",

    x %in% c("Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale") ~ "High-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
      "Lazy-Rich-Context",
      "Lazy+RichCtx",
      "Lazy Rich-Context",
      "Low-High-Contex",
      "Low-High-Context",
      "Low+HighCtx",
      "Low-Scale-High-Context",
      "Low-Scale + High Context"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
      "Rich-Lazy-Context",
      "Rich+LazyCtx",
      "Rich Lazy-Context",
      "High-Low-Contex",
      "High-Low-Context",
      "High+LowCtx",
      "High-Scale-Low-Context",
      "High-Scale + Low Context"
    ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build SRN acquisition dataframe
# ---------------------------------------------------------

srn_acq <- bind_rows(
  rich_poor_learning_dynamics_noContext %>%
    filter(global_step <= 90, training_active == TRUE) %>%
    mutate(condition = "NoContext"),

  rich_poor_learning_dynamics_maze %>%
    filter(global_step <= 90, training_active == TRUE) %>%
    mutate(condition = "Maze"),

  rich_poor_learning_dynamics_melody %>%
    filter(global_step <= 90, training_active == TRUE) %>%
    mutate(condition = "Melody"),

  rich_poor_learning_dynamics %>%
    filter(global_step <= 90, training_active == TRUE) %>%
    mutate(condition = "Maze-Melody")
) %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
    condition = factor(
      condition,
      levels = c("NoContext", "Maze", "Melody", "Maze-Melody")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_type)) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, model_type, condition) %>%
  arrange(global_step, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    practice0 = row_number() - 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    practice_c = as.numeric(scale(practice0, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    group2 = if_else(condition == "Maze-Melody", "Maze-Melody", "Other"),
    group2 = factor(group2, levels = c("Other", "Maze-Melody"))
  )

# quick check
#srn_acq %>% count(model_type, condition)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Original omnibus model, now with four model conditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

m_srn_omnibus <- lmer(
  loss ~ practice_c * group2 * model_type + (1 | participant_id),
  data = srn_acq,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(m_srn_omnibus)
anova(m_srn_omnibus)

# Optional planned comparisons
emm_srn <- emmeans(
  m_srn_omnibus,
  ~ model_type | group2
)

emm_srn
pairs(emm_srn)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# =========================
# 1. Packages
# =========================
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(gifski)

# =========================
# 2. Read / clean data
# =========================

# Context colors
cols <- c(Maze = "blue", Melody = "red")

# Model ordering and colors
model_levels <- c(
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context",
  "High-Scale"
)

clean_model_type <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c(
      "Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale"
    ) ~ "High-Scale",

    x %in% c(
      "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
      "Lazy-Rich-Context",
      "Lazy+RichCtx",
      "Lazy Rich-Context",
      "Low-High-Contex",
      "Low-High-Context",
      "Low+HighCtx",
      "Low-Scale-High-Context",
      "Low-Scale + High Context"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

    x %in% c(
      "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
      "Rich-Lazy-Context",
      "Rich+LazyCtx",
      "Rich Lazy-Context",
      "High-Low-Contex",
      "High-Low-Context",
      "High+LowCtx",
      "High-Scale-Low-Context",
      "High-Scale + Low Context"
    ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

clean_context <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(tolower(x), "maze") ~ "Maze",
    str_detect(tolower(x), "melody") ~ "Melody",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}

fix_model_type <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename_with(tolower) %>%
    mutate(
      model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
      model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
      context = clean_context(context),
      context = factor(context, levels = c("Maze", "Melody"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(model_type))
}

pca <- read_csv(
  "/Users/mg9965/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/ResearchProjects/RI-EVC/SRN/CogSci/results_mazeMelodyID_clean_all/shared_pca_trajectories.csv"
)

pca_use <- fix_model_type(pca)

# Keep only Maze and Melody for the GIF
pca_use <- pca_use %>%
  filter(context %in% c("Maze", "Melody"))

# =========================
# 3. Average PCA trajectory
#    at each checkpoint
# =========================

pca_mean <- pca_use %>%
  group_by(checkpoint_value, model_type, context, step_in_sequence) %>%
  summarise(
    pc1 = mean(pc1, na.rm = TRUE),
    pc2 = mean(pc2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Shared limits across all checkpoints and model types
xlims <- range(pca_mean$pc1, na.rm = TRUE)
ylims <- range(pca_mean$pc2, na.rm = TRUE)

# =========================
# 4. Helpers
# =========================

base_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1.5,
      linetype = "solid"
    ),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  )

prep_model_df <- function(df, checkpoint_now, model_label) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(
      checkpoint_value == checkpoint_now,
      model_type == model_label
    ) %>%
    arrange(context, step_in_sequence) %>%
    group_by(context) %>%
    mutate(
      step_alpha = scales::rescale(step_in_sequence, to = c(0.25, 1.0))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  starts <- d %>%
    group_by(context) %>%
    slice_min(step_in_sequence, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  ends <- d %>%
    group_by(context) %>%
    slice_max(step_in_sequence, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  list(d = d, starts = starts, ends = ends)
}

make_single_pca_plot <- function(parts, model_label, checkpoint_now, xlims, ylims) {
  ggplot(parts$d, aes(x = pc1, y = pc2)) +
    geom_path(
      aes(group = context, color = context),
      linewidth = 2.5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = context, alpha = step_alpha),
      size = 4.5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = parts$starts,
      aes(color = context),
      size = 6,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      stroke = 1.5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = parts$ends,
      aes(color = context),
      size = 6,
      shape = 16,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = xlims, ylim = ylims) +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = model_label,
      x = "PC1",
      y = "PC2"
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          shape = 16,
          size = 6,
          alpha = 1,
          linewidth = 0
        )
      )
    ) +
    base_theme
}

make_frame_plot <- function(checkpoint_now, df = pca_mean, xlims, ylims) {

  present_models <- model_levels[
    model_levels %in%
      as.character(unique(df$model_type[df$checkpoint_value == checkpoint_now]))
  ]

  plot_list <- lapply(
    present_models,
    function(model_label) {
      parts <- prep_model_df(
        df = df,
        checkpoint_now = checkpoint_now,
        model_label = model_label
      )

      make_single_pca_plot(
        parts = parts,
        model_label = model_label,
        checkpoint_now = checkpoint_now,
        xlims = xlims,
        ylims = ylims
      )
    }
  )

  names(plot_list) <- present_models

  combined <- wrap_plots(
    plotlist = plot_list,
    ncol = 2,
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(
        "PCA trajectories across training | checkpoint = ",
        checkpoint_now
      )
    )

  combined & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# =========================
# 5. Save all frames
# =========================

frame_dir <- "/Users/mg9965/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/ResearchProjects/RI-EVC/SRN/figures/PDP/pca_gif_frames"
dir.create(frame_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

checkpoints <- sort(unique(pca_mean$checkpoint_value))

# Optional: thin frames for a shorter GIF
# checkpoints <- checkpoints[seq(1, length(checkpoints), by = 2)]

for (i in seq_along(checkpoints)) {
  ckpt <- checkpoints[i]

  message(
    "Saving frame ",
    i,
    " / ",
    length(checkpoints),
    " (checkpoint = ",
    ckpt,
    ")"
  )

  p_frame <- make_frame_plot(
    checkpoint_now = ckpt,
    df = pca_mean,
    xlims = xlims,
    ylims = ylims
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(frame_dir, sprintf("frame_%03d.png", i)),
    plot = p_frame,
    width = 14,
    height = 12,
    dpi = 200,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# =========================
# 6. Turn frames into GIF
# =========================

png_files <- list.files(
  frame_dir,
  pattern = "\\.png$",

gifski(
  png_files = png_files,
```

```{r collapse-training-lmer-matched-style, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)

# =========================================================
# Collapse training stats - mixed effects
# Same analysis structure as matched stats,
# now across all 500 training steps
# =========================================================

# -----------------------------
# 1. Define model levels if needed
# -----------------------------

model_levels <- c(
  "Low-Scale",
  "Low-Scale + High Context",
  "High-Scale + Low Context",
  "High-Scale"
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Prepare training trajectory data
# -----------------------------

collapse_training_lmer <- collapse_training_clean %>%
  filter(step_or_epoch <= 500) %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
    step = as.numeric(step_or_epoch),
    step_c = scale(step, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
    
    # Use a unique run ID so IDs do not collide across model conditions.
    participant_id = interaction(
      model_type,
      global_scale,
      context_scale,
      participant_id,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(model_type),
    !is.na(step_c),
    !is.na(participant_id)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 3. Helper to fit one model
# -----------------------------

fit_lmer_training <- function(data, outcome) {
  
  formula_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ model_type * step_c + (1 + step_c || participant_id)")
  )
  
  model <- lmer(
    formula_full,
    data = data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )
  
  # fallback if singular / unstable
  if (isSingular(model, tol = 1e-4)) {
    
    formula_simple <- as.formula(
      paste0(outcome, " ~ model_type * step_c + (1 | participant_id)")
    )
    
    model <- lmer(
      formula_simple,
      data = data,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = lmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa",
        optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
      )
    )
  }
  
  model
}

# -----------------------------
# 4. Fit models for each outcome
# -----------------------------

m_loss_500   <- fit_lmer_training(collapse_training_lmer, "loss")
m_acc_500    <- fit_lmer_training(collapse_training_lmer, "accuracy")
m_decode_500 <- fit_lmer_training(collapse_training_lmer, "context_decodability")
m_weight_500 <- fit_lmer_training(collapse_training_lmer, "weight_ratio_cx_in")
m_dim_500    <- fit_lmer_training(collapse_training_lmer, "effective_dimensionality")
m_sep_500    <- fit_lmer_training(collapse_training_lmer, "trajectory_separation")

# -----------------------------
# 5. Inspect results
# -----------------------------

anova(m_loss_500)
summary(m_loss_500)

anova(m_acc_500)
summary(m_acc_500)

anova(m_decode_500)
summary(m_decode_500)

anova(m_weight_500)
summary(m_weight_500)

anova(m_dim_500)
summary(m_dim_500)

anova(m_sep_500)
summary(m_sep_500)

# -----------------------------
# 6. Compact ANOVA table
# -----------------------------

collapse_lmer_models <- list(
  loss = m_loss_500,
  accuracy = m_acc_500,
  context_decodability = m_decode_500,
  weight_ratio_cx_in = m_weight_500,
  effective_dimensionality = m_dim_500,
  trajectory_separation = m_sep_500
)

collapse_lmer_anova_table <- map_df(
  names(collapse_lmer_models),
  function(metric_name) {
    
    aov_i <- anova(collapse_lmer_models[[metric_name]]) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("term")
    
    aov_i %>%
      mutate(metric = metric_name) %>%
      select(metric, term, everything())
  }
)

collapse_lmer_anova_table

# -----------------------------
# 7. Optional: compact fixed-effect summaries
# -----------------------------

collapse_lmer_fixed_effects <- map_df(
  names(collapse_lmer_models),
  function(metric_name) {
    
    coef_i <- summary(collapse_lmer_models[[metric_name]])$coefficients %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("term")
    
    coef_i %>%
      mutate(metric = metric_name) %>%
      select(metric, term, everything())
  }
)

collapse_lmer_fixed_effects
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

# ==========================================================
# Join transition cost and centroid distance by network
# ==========================================================

cor_df <- switch_units_loss %>%
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    Model_Type = clean_model_type(agent),
    transition_cost = mean_cost
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model_Type = factor(Model_Type, levels = model_levels)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    mixed_split %>%
      transmute(
        participant_id,
        Model_Type,
        centroid_distance = d_split
      ),
    by = c("participant_id", "Model_Type")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(transition_cost),
    is.finite(centroid_distance)
  )

# Check that each row represents one network
cor_df %>%
  count(Model_Type)

cor_test <- cor.test(
  cor_df$centroid_distance,
  cor_df$transition_cost,
  method = "pearson"
)

cor_test

r_value <- unname(cor_test$estimate)
p_value <- cor_test$p.value
n_value <- nrow(cor_df)

cor_label <- paste0(
  "r = ", sprintf("%.2f", r_value),
  ", p ",
  ifelse(
    p_value < .001,
    "< .001",
    paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))
  )
)

correlation_plot <- ggplot(
  cor_df,
  aes(
    x = centroid_distance,
    y = transition_cost,
    color = Model_Type
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 6,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +

  # Overall regression line with no confidence ribbon
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 4,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = model_cols,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Centroid Distance (PC space)",
    y = "Transition Cost",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 4
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 36),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

correlation_plot
```
